title: Administrator
description: To provide efficient administrative support to the CYP0-19 Public Health Service for the children, young people and families ,supporting the implementation of the Healthy Child Programme . The post holder will be the main point of contact for the administration of appointments within the CYP 0-19 years service for parents/carers and young people of Oxfordshire. The post holder will work within the team in our SPA(Single Point of Access). To provide comprehensive timely administrative support to our Children and Young People Public Health Service, incorporating Health Visiting, School Health Nursing and Family Nurse Partnership. Managing databases ,using Microsoft platforms ,Excel and updating information on Electronic Health Records. Prioritise work accordingly ,following the CYP 0-19 Public Health Service Standard Operating Procedures (SOPS). Responding to the needs of service and the clients in a timely manner. Perform general office duties, including responding to emails and phone enquiries appropriately following Trust procedures. Be able to work independently, proactively and as part of a team. Standard Operating Proceedures. JOB PURPOSE To provide efficient administrative support to the 0-19 CYP Public Health Service for the children, young people, and families, supporting the implementation of the 0-19 Healthy Child Programme (HCP) Accurately inputting data and maintaining database information systems. This includes collating information from partner services and organisations. The post holder will be the main point of contact for the administration of appointments within the 0-19 CYP Public Health Service for parent/carers and young people, in Oxfordshire. The Post Holder will work as part of the Single Point of access (SPA). When appropriate hold a ChatHealth Licence to provide administrative support to the practitioners working on the platform. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Clinical responsibilities: To provide comprehensive, timely administrative support to the 0-19 CYP Public Health Service. Working within a Single Point of Access (SPA). databases and Microsoft Office Responsible for accurately inputting, correcting, and closing patient information on their Electronic Health Records (EHR), using relevant clinical applications. Ensuring that all referrals received are tracked through to team allocation and any problems are resolved. Prioritise workload, accordingly, following the 0-19 CYP Public Health Service , Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and policies, responding to the needs of service and the clients in a timely manner. Have good organisational abilities, to be able to manage own workload and contribute to the organisation of the relevant team. Communicate politely and effectively with clients, healthcare staff, and others, courteously and responsively. Establish and maintain clinician and clinic diaries, arranging meetings, making appointments, and resolving diary conflicts. Scheduling and re-arranging diary entries, ensuring accurate record keeping and outcoming of appointments. To perform general office duties including responding to email and phone enquiries. Answering the telephone, taking, and recording messages accurately, responding to queries appropriately, following Trust procedures and protocols and organise the maintenance of the electronic filing systems for the relevant team. Taking and producing accurate meeting minutes and follow up any actions arising. To maintain service supplies: order, check, maintain and distribute equipment and supplies for the team as required. Then receipt orders. Undertake photocopying and scanning as required. Contacting the Estates or Facilities Department to carry out repairs, checking work has been undertaken to satisfaction. Provide cover for other team members and provide cross cover within the directorate and across the Trust as required. To provide feedback to 0-19 CYP Public Health Service managers to improve ways of working within the team and to assist managers in the development, testing and implementation of new IT, telephony, and information systems. escalating to line manager/LTL any concerns with undertaking any tasks. title: Administrator
description: Are you looking for a new office based challenge working for a hardworking enthusiastic and vibrant mental health service? Would you like to be part of a well functioning team which values the wellbeing of all members of the team and prides itself on being a team people want people want to work for? We are seeking a part time Administrator to join the team! Based within the Oxfordshire Early Intervention Service (OEIS) office, the post holder will undertake a range of day to day administrative duties including managing records, processing referrals, coordinating meetings, maintaining electronic systems, and supporting communication across the team. We would love to hear from you should this exciting role appeal to you. Please contact Cynthia Wakonyo (Performance & Administration Manager) if you have any questions regarding this post. Be responsible for providing an efficient administrative/secretarial service to the OEIS team Be a contact and channel of communication between users of the service and the team, maintaining a professional but sympathetic manner. Taking minutes of meetings. Deal appropriately with sensitive and confidential information from the clinical team using initiative to direct appropriately. Provide reception cover Provide ad hoc, flexible, and focussed admin support to the team as required, ensuring that the office is stocked with relevant forms and stationery to ensure a smooth-running office. We hope that the advert has given you a clear understanding of the skills we are seeking and the opportunity at hand. You will need to use the supporting statement element of your application form to demonstrate your suitability for this role and you should refer to the job description, person specification and the guidance notes attached to this role to help you tailor your application. The essential and desirable criteria will be used to shortlist for interview, and you should ensure that you refer to these within your application to increase your chances of being selected for interview.

title: Forensic Administrator - Littlemore, Oxford
description: We are looking for an excellent Administrator to join our admin team at Oxford Clinic, Littlemore Mental Health Centre in Oxford. You will work with senior members of the multidisciplinary team to provide direct administrative support. We are looking for an enthusiastic, flexible, empathetic and self-motivated individual to work within our team. Please note the interview is face to face and will contain a minute taking exercise. The successful candidate will need to have proven administrative experience with a good eye for detail, excellent communication, administrative and organisational / prioritisation skills, knowledge of Microsoft Office, Word, Excel, managing Outlook diaries, and minute taking and will be able to liaise with employees at all levels. They will also have the skills to handle all contacts confidently with compassion, patience and professionalism. The role will suit someone who enjoys being busy, where they would be able to work as a part of a team, as well as using their own initiative. This is an important role which helps run an efficient service but is also an extremely rewarding one. We will offer the successful candidate a supportive team, with regular supervision meetings, opportunities for continued professional development and a friendly and sometimes challenging working environment. We are looking for an individual with Experience of working within an administrative role Good communication skills Good written and verbal skills Experience of servicing meetings including minute taking. Word processing experience with audio and copy typing The ability to work under pressure Ability to prioritise own workload An understanding of GDPR and the Data Protection Act A commitment to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and vulnerable adults. Knowledge of Microsoft Office packages including Microsoft Teams
